newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht weaker late, interbank rises.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht weaker late, interbank rises.

text.p: The Thai baht was weaker against the dollar as the greenback's continued to post gains on the yen and there was limited speculative pressure on the currency, dealers said.
The baht was quoted at 26.110-26.145 per dollar late on Monday against 26.130-26.135 earlier.
"I think it is very much following dollar yen but there seems to be a little speculative pressure in the market though as a whole the spot is not that active," said a dealer at a major Thai bank.
The baht's decline on the spot market pushed the one month swap premium to 4.00/5.50 satang per dollar against 3.75/4.25 satang earlier, dealers said.
The interbank overnight offered rate rose to 7.75-8.25 percent against 7.50 percent ealier as spot buying of dollars for baht contributed to a slight tightening of liquidity, traders said.
